summary: @keyframes describes the steps of an animation, and the animation property runs it on an element. Unlike a transition, it does not need a state change like hover to start.
notes: animation: pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate fades the dot down and back up forever.
fill-up has only a from step. The to step is the element's normal width (75%), so the bar ends at 18 of 24.
With reduced motion turned on in the system settings, the animations stop and the bar shows at 75% right away.
pitfall: Misspelling the animation name, such as animation: pluse 1s. Nothing moves and there is no error message.
